notes.title: Version 0.9.9 - German Language Pack
notes.notes: Along with some minor fixes, we have finally added the [b]German language[/b] option.

notes.title: 29/11/2024 - 0.9.8 FIXED
notes.notes: Ooopsie we have fixed a breaking bug from the previous version.

notes.title: 0.9.8 - sound and cutscene fix
notes.notes:
We’re back with some fixes after having [b]our game played by FOUR streamers on Twitch[/b]! This experience gave us valuable insights into what to fix and change to improve your gameplay experience, and we’re already working on some updates. 🎥

In this minor update, we’ve fixed some [i]Minotaur [/i]sound effects and made a small adjustment to the cutscene to prevent accidentally skipping dialogues. 💬

notes.title: ⭐ 0.9.7 patch 🐸
notes.notes:
⭐ Since the final section of the sewer area seems a bit challenging for some players, we've added cameras to help suggest how the levers work and which paths they open.
⭐ We've also made a few other small fixes such as the hp upgrade animation des-synchronizing from the actual hp level.

notes.title: The Yapping update 📣
notes.notes:
📣 The world of Frogbound just got a little noisier! With this update, our quirky cast of characters has found their "voice" (sort of). Dive into the adventure and hear Sir Hopper and friends ribbit their thoughts like never before!

⭐btw we also fixed some nasty little bugs as usual

notes.title: New language support
notes.notes: Added support for two new languages: spanish and romagnolo (italian dialect).
